claim.claim-text: 1. A method for satellite communication, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the modulating comprises extracting an ACM information field from the ACM tagged frame, to generate, based on the ACM information field, the modulated signal.
3. The method of any one of claims 1-2, further comprising: generating, based on the modulated signal, an I/Q baseband signal, wherein the modulated signal comprises an I/Q digital signal.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the generating the filtered baseband signal comprises generating, based on the I/Q baseband signal, the filtered baseband signal.
5. The method of any one of claims 1-4, further comprising:
receiving an equalization vector; and applying, based on the equalization vector, equalization to the modulated signal, wherein the modulated signal comprises an I/Q digital signal.
6. The method of any one of claims 1 - 5, further comprising: applying digital pre-distortion to the modulated signal, wherein the modulated signal comprises an I/Q digital signal.
7. The method of any one of claims 1 - 6, further comprising:

associating, based on a second carrier identifier included in at least one second stripped frame, a second ACM tagged frame included in the at least one second stripped frame with a second carrier corresponding the second carrier identifier; and extracting a second baseband frame included in the second ACM tagged frame.
8. The method of any one of claims 1 - 7, further comprising: causing transmission of a radio frequency (RF) signal corresponding to the filtered baseband signal.
9. A method for satellite communication, the method comprising:
10. The method of claim 9, further comprising:
filtering an input signal to output a filtered input signal; and outputting, at the IF band, a portion of the filtered input signal corresponding to a reception frequency band.

11. The method of claim 10, further comprising: generating different output signals associated with the IF band, each of the different output signals corresponding to a portion of an input signal associated with a different portion of the reception frequency band, wherein the different output signals correspond to the reception frequency band.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the reception frequency band corresponds to a Ka-band, a Q-band, or a V-band.
13. A non-transitory computer-readable medium storing instructions that, when executed, cause the method of any one of claims 1-8.
14. An apparatus configured to perform the method of any one of claims 1-12.
15. A system comprising:
an apparatus configured to perform the method of any one of claims 1-12; and a terminal configured to receive the RF signal.
